title: SR-4.07 memev uses the live hosted services
request: Closes G101: the seed-stage analysis (A8, C7). memev has no built-in licence endpoint (src/cli/licensing.mjs:55-57 reads only --server and MEMEV_LICENSE_URL) and no built-in checkout address (docs/CHECKOUT.md: memev upgrade prints checkout.url from the vault's config), and hosted sync, backup and relay answer that they are not offered yet (src/services/providers.mjs:12). SR-4.02 to SR-4.05 build the services in memev-cloud and SR-5.01 the live checkout, but no contract makes memev use them. The repository still carries no address (docs/CHECKOUT.md says so, and the leak denylist names the company's domain), so a release takes the addresses from release configuration, never from the source. Repository: memev. Depends on contracts: SR-4.02, SR-4.03, SR-4.04, SR-4.05, SR-5.01, QL-1.02.

tasks.title: A release knows where the licence server and the checkout are
requirements: the release workflow writes the licence endpoint and the checkout URL into the package it publishes, as a release config file read at start, from the repository variables MEMEV_RELEASE_LICENSE_URL and MEMEV_RELEASE_CHECKOUT_URL; no address appears in the repository's text and the leak scan still passes

precedence is --server, then MEMEV_LICENSE_URL, then the vault config, then the release config; a build from a checkout without the release config behaves as today (no address, and the command says none is set)
memev activate and memev upgrade contact nothing until the person runs them, and no other command reads or contacts these addresses, so the no-telemetry statement stays true
a release whose variables lack either address fails before anything is published

criteria.statement: SR-4.07 release config: with a release config naming a stub licence server, memev activate <key> reaches the stub with no flag or variable set; --server, MEMEV_LICENSE_URL and the vault config each override it in that order; without the file the command says no licence server is set; no other command contacts the stub (the stub counts requests)

tasks.title: Hosted sync, backup and relay through the live services
requirements: src/services/providers.mjs offers hosted sync, hosted backup and the hosted relay when the licence's entitlements include sync_hosted, backup_hosted and relay_hosted and the release config names the service address; each speaks the protocol of SR-4.03, SR-4.05 and SR-4.04, with sync and backup end-to-end encrypted as SR-4.03 requires
without the entitlement or the address each says why it is not available and names the tier that includes it; no provider says it is not offered yet
memev doctor reports each hosted service as off, not entitled, reachable or failing, and contacts a service only when it is on

criteria.statement: SR-4.07 hosted: against stub services that implement SR-4.03's sync and SR-4.05's backup protocols, a licensed vault syncs a note to a second vault and restores a backup byte for byte; the stub store holds no plaintext; an unlicensed vault is refused naming the tier; a provider that still answers not offered yet fails the test
